# Read the stack trace

Start at the innermost frame that belongs to the repository under test.

# Bisect a regression

Halve the suspect range; never guess twice in the same direction.

# Run focused tests

Run the single failing test before the module, and the module before the suite.

# Write the failing test first

A fix with no failing test in front of it is a guess.
Orient in the repository, then change one thing.
The focused-test skill paid for itself twice this week.
